headline: A 2020 law names a Montana mountain ridge the "B-47 Ridge" to honor an Air Force bomber crash and allows a memorial plaque.
what_it_does: The law designates the mountain ridge south and west of Emigrant Peak in Montana's Absaroka Range as the "B-47 Ridge." The ridge is where an Air Force B-47 bomber crashed during a 1962 training mission. The law also allows a plaque to be installed on the ridge in memory of the crash.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on October 13, 2020.
